Hi Alice and Bob,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good discussion and appreciate the context. Below is a short recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum. Please flag anything I missed or any changes to dates/stakeholders.

Key pain points and goals
- Pain: inconsistent response latency for model-powered search and high per-token costs at peak throughput.
- Goal: reduce tail latency to <150ms for interactive flows and cut inference cost by ~30% within production deployment.
- Constraints: must integrate with existing VPC and use company-managed KMS; SOC 2 evidence required for procurement.

Stakeholders (from today)
- Alice Johnson — Head of Product (buyer)
- Bob Lee — Platform Engineering (technical lead)
- Lara Gomez — VP Engineering (decision approver, will confirm on next call)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Aditya Rao (Solutions Engineer)

Proposed MAP (milestones & owners)
1) Technical discovery & infra fit-check — Week of Jun 15 — Owner: Bob Lee + Aditya Rao
2) POC plan & data prep — Jun 22 — Owner: Product/Platform + Redwood SE
3) POC execution (2 weeks) — Jul 6 — Owner: Bob Lee + Redwood runtime team
4) Eval & metrics review — Jul 20 — Owner: Alice Johnson + Marissa Cole
5) Procurement & legal (SOC 2 + SOW) — Jul 27 — Owner: Alice (procurement) + Redwood legal
6) Final decision/commit — Aug 3 — Owner: Lara Gomez

Next steps I will take
- Share the editable MAP spreadsheet (attached) and a short technical intake checklist.
- Schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive with Bob and Aditya for w/c Jun 15 — proposed slots Tue/Wed morning PT.

Please confirm the stakeholders and whether the milestones/dates look reasonable. If timing is tight, we can compress the POC window.

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP w/ milestones)
Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cAcmeMAP

Best,
